svg.title: AI Automation for Product Photos & Images
svg.desc: Seven-stage split-screen transformation and fan-out workflow for product photos: a seller uploads a phone photo via webhook, computer vision cuts out the product from its messy backdrop, a transformation beam sends it via API to Adobe Firefly and Midjourney to generate brand-fit scenes, the product stamps onto three fanned-out backdrop variants, a Make scenario exports channel sizes, a human picks the finals, and listing-ready images save to Google Drive and Shopify.
svg.text: Phone shot → AI cut-out → 3 backdrops → Shopify
